observation: Primary browser accessibility output presents exactly four workspace radios: Explore, Dissect, Guided learning and Quiz. Read-only embedded DOM inspection confirms four additional native form inputs are aria-hidden=true, clipped to inset(50%), 1px square and tabIndex=-1. These are not extra learner-facing controls. The selected visible Explore radio has tabIndex=0; other visible radios have tabIndex=-1.
outcome: The earlier doubled DOM snapshot is not evidence of a duplicated accessible-control defect; no product patch justified by this bounded observation.
method: Actual accessibility tree plus read-only frame-scoped DOM/style inspection. No injected scripts, preference changes, form edits, submissions or model selection.
limits: Not a full screen-reader or assistive-technology acceptance test.
No 200% text, reduced-motion, performance or GPU measurement.
No full model-load or clinical acceptance claim.
No raw DOM, scan images, private data or review decisions included.
